name: steam-search
title: Steam Search
description: Search the Steam store, check prices, reviews and player counts, and open games directly in the Steam client or on GG.deals.
author: wvrnnr

preferences.name: region
preferences.title: Region & Currency
preferences.description: Used for Steam prices and GG.deals keyshop prices.

preferences.name: steamApiKey
preferences.title: Steam API Key
preferences.description:
steamcommunity.com/dev/apikey
Used for Recently Played, Friends Online & Wishlist Discounts tabs, as well as Playtime & Wishlisted badges on games
preferences.placeholder: Optional — enables Owned, Recently Played, Wishlist Discounts, Friends Online

preferences.name: steamId
preferences.title: Steam ID (64-bit)
preferences.description:
steamid.io
Used alongside your Steam API key for all features to work properly
preferences.placeholder: Optional — enables Owned, Recently Played, Wishlist Discounts, Friends Online

preferences.name: ggDealsApiKey
preferences.title: GG.deals API Key
preferences.description:
gg.deals/api
Used for displaying the lowest keyshop price for (almost) every game
preferences.placeholder: Optional — enables keyshop prices in search and Wishlist Discounts

commands.name: index
commands.title: Steam Search
commands.description: Search for games on Steam and open them in the Steam client
